the proposed frequency estimators are capable of achieving CRLB for white Gaussian noise, with the exception of the threshold region.

the linear prediction-based approach is an attractive alternative for frequency estimation of multiple tones in white Gaussian noise.
the linear prediction approach can provide accurate and computationally simple frequency estimators.
the two constrained weighted least-squares frequency estimators provide a simple, computationally efficient, and accurate approach for estimating multiple real tones in white Gaussian noise.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, for the single-tone case, both constrained weighted least-squares algorithms provide nearly identical frequency estimation and the performance of both estimators approaches the CRLB in the absence of threshold effect.
the proposed estimators are computationally simple and efficient in terms of frequency estimation performance.
, with the proposed estimators, the frequency estimates of multiple real sinusoidal signals embedded in white noise approach the CRLB before the threshold effect is observed.
